checkpoints.section: GEOGRAPHIC ORIGIN CHECK � THIS IS THE KEY TEST
checkpoints.step: � EU regime geographic check:
checkpoints.expected: - Origin airport: YYZ (Toronto, Canada) - Origin country: CANADA - Is Canada an EU/EEA member state? ? NO - Is Canada the United Kingdom? ? NO - EU regulation 261/2004 requires flight to DEPART FROM an EU/EEA/UK airport - YYZ is NOT in the EU/EEA/UK - Result: ITINERARY DID NOT START IN EU ? NOT ELIGIBLE

checkpoints.step: - APPR: NO geographic origin check � applies to all Canadian airline flights
checkpoints.expected: - EU: Flight must DEPART FROM EU/EEA/UK airport (origin check ONLY) - ASL: Flight must DEPART FROM AND ARRIVE IN Israel (BOTH origin + destination) NOTE: Even though the flight ARRIVES at LHR (EU/UK), under EU261 the regulation only applies to flights departing FROM the EU on non-EU carriers, or to/from EU on EU carriers. Since AC is a non-EU carrier and the flight departs from Canada, EU261 does NOT apply. NOTE: This itinerary WOULD be eligible under APPR (Canadian departure, AC flight, controllable delay ?2h). The system should route to APPR regime instead. However, this test case specifically validates the EU regime geographic gate � confirming that if the system attempts to evaluate under EU, it correctly rejects. � All further EU checks SKIPPED because geographic gate failed: ? Controllability check � SKIPPED (EU doesn't check anyway) ? Notification check � SKIPPED ? No-travel check � SKIPPED DDS RESPONSE CODE = SoC-EU-NE-06
